description: This file defines the Aws\CloudFront\Signer class, which provides functionality for creating signed URLs and cookies for AWS CloudFront. It includes methods for generating signatures using private keys, creating policies, and encoding signatures, essential for managing access control with CloudFront.
external_files: Could be any SSL private key file specified in constructor

classes.name: Signer
classes.description: Provides methods for signing CloudFront URLs and cookies, managing cryptographic signatures and policies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Signer object by loading the private key and setting the key pair ID.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Frees the loaded private key resource when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Creates signature components for signed URLs and cookies based on resource, expiration, and policy.

methods.name: createCannedPolicy
methods.description: Generates a JSON policy for restricted access to a specific resource until the specified expiration.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs the policy string with the private key to produce a cryptographic signature.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the policy or signature into a URL-safe base64 string.
